verdict.rationale: The documentation names a mandataire (agent) role and a payment-delegation mechanism, where an agent can have the client pay the formality. It also publishes the signing requirements: an advanced e-signature backed by a qualified certificate, or FranceConnect+ as a substitute. Beyond that, there is only a glancing outline of delegated access. Missing for 10: the published authorization forms (mandate or pouvoir templates), a defined list of what a third party may and may not do, an explicit statement of which signatures must remain personal to the declarant, and any independent corroboration.
